## 待裁(`needs-user-decision`):Studio 应用的根页面还是 `StudioHomePage`,要不要按你说的退役

分诊席(seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015)· `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-11T03:54Z。⛔ 不是认领,⛔ 不是派发。这是维护者要求开的卡(「要开卡：Studio 首页要不要退役」),选项按决策格式补齐。

### 一句话问题
你在 #12079 里说 `StudioHomePage`「早已退役,不该有人落在上面」。但在 objectui `main` 上,打开 Studio 应用时根页面仍然是它,侧边栏里也还有对应的"Studio 首页"入口。要不要真的退掉?

### 背景(objectui `main` `5330afd1f9`,本卡正文已列出)
- `AppContent.tsx` 的应用首页路由,最后一层兜底是 `<StudioHomePage />`:Studio 应用的导航全是 `component` 项,落地解析器不遍历这类项。
- `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` 里有 `isStudioHomeActive` 这个入口。
- 另有独立的 `/studio` 搭建器路由,Home 页的 Studio 按钮和 `StudioDesignSurface` 都跳到那里。

### 选项 × 后果 × 工作量
| 选项 | 做什么 | 用户看到的变化 | 工作量 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A 退役** | Studio 应用根页面直接重定向到 `/studio`;删掉 `StudioHomePage`、侧边栏的首页入口,以及两个读者(`useRecentItemLabel.ts`、`ContextSelectors.tsx`)里对它的引用 | 进 Studio 应用直接到搭建器,不再看到旧首页 | 1 个 PR,以删除为主,约 200–500 行(含测试) |
| **B 保留** | 不改代码,把 #12079 里"已退役"的说法更正为"保留为 Studio 应用的概览页" | 无变化 | 只改说法,不改代码 |

### 维护者速读
你之前说 Studio 旧首页早已退役,但现在打开 Studio 应用,落地的仍然是它。A:退掉它,根页面直接跳到 `/studio` 搭建器,1 个 PR、以删除为主;B:保留,只把"已退役"的说法改正。分诊推荐 A,与你之前的原话一致。

选 A 还是 B?

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:A 让 Studio 只有一个入口(`/studio`);B 保留两个入口。
- ② 实际业务拉动:你本人的原话(#12079)和本卡的请求。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 去掉一个"已退役却仍在用"的页面,不会再误导;B 需要把说法改对。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 净删除代码;B 不动代码。

Prior rulings read: objectui#12079 正文(维护者原话)· PR objectui#12091 的合约审查 · thread: none。

**推荐:A**(根页面重定向到 `/studio`),回退 B。
- 自检:只看①选 A;②③④ 不翻转。

### 裁后执行
- **A:** 本卡回 `pm:queue`(`domain:ui`,p3),范围按上表。
- **B:** 本卡改为一处说法更正后关闭。

Ruling: batch #315 item 2 · letter A1 · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-11T04:30Z

Director seat, summon #36, `session_019fWAt2renophxLVg5aJXMH` (GitHub `hotlong`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` via the relay). Presented in batch #315 as item 2, from the triage seat's decision request 6105201882 on this maintainer-requested card (「要开卡:Studio 首页要不要退役」); this seat split the triage's A into A1 (root to the app's own first navigation item) and A2 (root to `/studio`), recommended A1, and the maintainer answered 「同意」 to the batch. Thread-read: 6105201882. Freshness: body unchanged; labels `needs-user-decision`, `priority:p3`, `domain:ui`, `area:studio`; no assignee. Premises re-read on objectui `origin/main` `a21ff9a9`: `AppContent.tsx:70` lazy-imports the page and `:1104` is the index route's last fallback, `return <StudioHomePage />`, for "a navigation with no landing: the metadata-admin 'Studio' app, whose nav is built from `component` items the landing resolver does not walk"; `UnifiedSidebar.tsx:413` `isStudioHomeActive` and `:470` the Studio-only Home entry; `appServesNoNavigation.ts` says "Its root keeps rendering `StudioHomePage`"; `StudioHomePage.tsx` is a data-driven overview (greeting, KPI cards, Explore grid, quick actions, recent items) over `/meta/types` and the diagnostics sweep; readers `useRecentItemLabel.ts` and `ContextSelectors.tsx`; its two own tests (`displayLocale-10232`, `recentPackage-11863`) and three console tests name it (`AppContent.systemHubRoutes`, `orphanedPageComponentRefs-10520`, `ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591`); `/studio/*` is the pillar builder behind its own entry gate (`apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`).

## The ruling

**A1 — `StudioHomePage` retires; the Studio app's root resolves to the app's own first navigation item, like every other app's.** The index route's last fallback goes; the landing resolver learns to walk `component` items (it walks object, view and page items today), so the Studio app lands on its first item; the sidebar's Studio-only Home entry goes with the page; `StudioHomePage.tsx`, its export from `views/metadata-admin/index.ts`, its two own tests, and the references in `useRecentItemLabel.ts`, `ContextSelectors.tsx` and the three console tests are deleted or re-pointed; the `appServesNoNavigation.ts` note is reworded. objectui#12079's wording stands: the page was retired in the maintainer's words, and is now retired in code. The dev names the first item in the PR.

- ⛔ Not taken: **A2** (redirect the app root to `/studio`: the root would leave the app shell for a surface behind a different entry gate and break the sidebar's context, joining two Studio surfaces the platform keeps apart) and **B** (keep the overview and correct #12079's wording: a page the maintainer calls retired stays live, and the second home stays).
- Workload (#22597's rule): one objectui PR, deletion-led, about 200–500 lines including tests; the resolver change is a few lines; the console pin bump follows on its usual cadence.

Prior rulings read: objectui#12079 (the maintainer's words; the empty-navigation empty state landed as PR objectui#12091); the contract review of objectui#12091 (where the open question was raised); the 2026-08-05 ruling on the react layer's retired `objectName` / `viewType` (unrelated to the root). None rules the Studio root. 自检: 只看①选 A1;②③④ 是否翻转:否。置信缺口: the Studio app's first navigation item is not read item by item here (the dev names it); whether any deployment deep-links to the Studio root expecting the overview is unmeasured (the root still resolves, so such links keep working).

## State

- `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (`priority:p3`, `domain:ui`, `area:studio` kept) in this act; the `Ruled:` line added to the body and the filing-time ⛔ line struck. The `domain:ui` lane claims it.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#12165 (head `4957032d3f`), ruling A1 executed, with the claim amendment · `domain:ui` seat 2, `session_01TYgwmFK1q4KJ6Qq2WRLzsD`, 2026-10-11T22:49Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the diff, not the report (`os-dev-report` `6114636335`).

### Claim amendment (to claim `6109802426`)

The file surface is extended, each item declared in the PR body:
- `.changeset/12079-empty-nav-landing.md`: one pending bullet of objectui#12079 that this change makes false is reworded.
- `packages/app-shell/README.md`: its package-scope paragraph described the retired page.
- `AppPreview.docEntry-11197.test.tsx`: the test name only.

The H4 premise did not hold. `engine.home.*` lives only in the metadata-admin designer table, not in the `@object-ui/i18n` packs, so no pack moved. `Clause-②: no` stands, as the claim predicted.

### Verdict

- **Shape:**
  - Draft on `main`, first line `Fixes #12113`, and `Clause-②: no`.
  - `Fixes #12113` is the only closing keyword in the body.
  - Assignee `zhuangjianguo`.
- **Scope:** 26 files, +584/−900, led by deletions.
  - Nothing under `content/docs/releases/`.
  - `check-governed-merges --pr`: NOT governed, under 3000.
- **Contract review:** `6114746300`, PASS on this head. It is owed here because the diff edits another card's pending changeset.
  - ① The walk takes `component` entries through the one `resolveHref` builder. The Studio root opens the App Builder (`/apps/studio/component/studio/builder`, read on objectstack `main` `studio.app.ts`). The Account and Setup landings follow from ruling A1 as written and are disclosed.
  - ② `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch` is right. The reworded 12079 bullet is true in the tree it publishes from, and the edit is in proportion.
  - ③ Every flag is answered.
- **Against ruling `6105451919` (A1):**
  - Done, as the ruling lists:
    - the index route's last fallback is gone;
    - the walk learns `component` items;
    - the sidebar's Studio-only Home row is gone;
    - `StudioHomePage.tsx`, its barrel export and its two tests are deleted;
    - `useRecentItemLabel.ts`, `ContextSelectors.tsx`, `AppNoAccessEmptyState.tsx` and the six tests are re-pointed;
    - the `appServesNoNavigation.ts` note is reworded.
  - The dev names the first item in the PR (App Builder), as the ruling asks.
  - ⛔ No redirect to `/studio`, and no overview kept.
- **The landing change beyond Studio, disclosed in the changeset:**
  - the Account app opens on Profile, its first declared entry, instead of Notifications;
  - Setup, for a caller without the System Overview group, opens on Packages instead of Users;
  - an app whose entries all lead out of it shows no page at its root.

  The review reads these as the ruling's own mechanism applied, so they are not escalated. They are named in the seat's report to the maintainer.
- **Changeset and docs, checked sentence by sentence against the diff:**
  - The `12113` changeset's Studio URL, its removed-with-the-page list (the Home row, and `engine.home.*` except `engine.home.recent`, which `BuilderLanding` reads) and its consequence list match the code and the review's objectstack reads.
  - The reworded `12079` bullet ("does not get the empty state … its root opens … the app's first navigation entry") matches `appServesNoNavigation` and the walk.
  - The `content/docs/guide/console.md` "Studio Package Scope" row and the app-shell README sentence both say the Studio app has no home page of its own and opens its first entry that leads to a page.
- **Evidence:**
  - Three new pins.
  - The ablation, run on committed `6e2bcdb` with the walk's component arm removed: 3 red (the Studio root, the component-first case and the 12079 Studio control), every control green, and the restore blob-equal.
  - The eager closure shrinks by 1826 B gzip, from 291 to 289 eager chunks.
- **Gates on this head** (read at 2026-10-11T22:49Z): 40 success, 3 skipped by design (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)` and the coverage-shard placeholder), 0 failure; all eight `Test` shards concluded `success`. `Lint`, `Type Check` and `Test` all read `success`. `check-governed-merges --pr`: NOT governed, 1484 changed lines.

### Out-of-scope findings and notes

All three are Acceptance notes, carrier none, as the PR body carries them:
- `AppHeader.tsx`'s Profile comment, which this change makes stale;
